items.title: IICA hosts important session on ‘IBC as an Evolving Law Through the Amendments’,.
items.summary: Under the “Meet the Legend” programme, the Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA), Manesar, hosted an insightful session on “IBC as an Evolving Law Through the Amendments” featuring Dr. M. S. Sahoo , former Chairperson of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI) and a well-known figure in the development and evolution of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC).

items.title: Biometric Aadhaar Authentication Mandatory for Subsidised Domestic LPG Refills from 1 October 2026
items.summary: From 1 October 2026, domestic LPG consumers will need to have completed Biometric Aadhaar Authentication (BAA) to book refills at the regulated Retail Selling Price (RSP) with applicable subsidy. BAA ensures that subsidised LPG reaches only genuine and deserving households.

items.title: Indian Railways Approves ₹252 Crore for Kavach 4.0 on 607.7 Route Kilometres of Lucknow Division
items.summary: In a significant step towards strengthening railway safety through indigenous technology, Indian Railways has approved the provision of Kavach Version 4.0 on 607.7 Route Kilometres of the Lucknow Division of North Eastern Railway at a total cost of ₹252 crore. The approved project will extend Kavach 4.0 coverage across the identified balance sections of the division, strengthening the safety infrastructure available for train operations.

items.title: Indian Railways Approves ₹209 Crore for Electronic Interlocking at 7 Stations in Solapur Division
items.summary: Indian Railways has approved the provision of Electronic Interlocking (EI) at seven stations of Solapur Division of Central Railway at a total cost of ₹209 crore. The approved work involves provision of Electronic Interlocking at Mohol, Mundhewadi, Bale, Solapur, Hotgi Junction-Hotgi A Cabin, Shahabad and Wadi Junction on the High Density Network (HDN) 7 route, where Kavach, Automatic Block Signalling (ABS) and Centralised Traffic Control (CTC) works have ...

items.title: Indian Railways Approves ₹142 Crore for Upgradation of Electric Traction System to 2x25 kV on 73 RKM Savalyapuram-Guntur Section
items.summary: Indian Railways has approved the upgradation of the electric traction system from 1x25 kV to 2x25 kV on the 73 Route Kilometre Savalyapuram-Guntur section of South Coast Railway at a total cost of ₹142 crore. Covering 146 Track Kilometres, the project will strengthen the electric traction infrastructure and enhance its capacity to support growing railway operations.

items.title: Indian Railways Approves ₹133 Crore for Construction of Four-Lane Road Over Bridge on Udhna-Ukai Songadh Section of Western Railway
items.summary: Indian Railways has approved the construction of a four-lane Road Over Bridge (ROB) in lieu of Level Crossing No. 53 at Km 62/2-4 on the Udhna-Ukai Songadh section of Western Railway, at a total cost of ₹133.2295 crore, on a cost-sharing basis with the State Government. The ROB will be a four-lane structure. The Railway bridge portion will comprise an Open Web Girder (OWG), with an estimated cost of ₹91.60 crore.

items.title: TRAI Strengthens Framework for Curbing Unsolicited Commercial Communications through Technology-Driven Enforcement and Enhanced Consumer Protection
items.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has amended the Telecom Commercial Communications Customer Preference Regulations, 2018 (TCCCPR, 2018) to further strengthen the regulatory framework for curbing Unsolicited Commercial Communications (UCC), protect consumers from spam and prevent misuse of telecom resources for sending UCC.

items.ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
items.title: Government Relaxes Sugar Stockholding Limit for Bulk Consumers from 15 to 30 Days, Additional stock to be sourced exclusively from imported sugar under Advance Authorization Scheme (AAS) and Tariff Rate Quota (TRQ)
items.summary: The Government has decided that the existing 15 days’ stockholding limit for bulk consumers is relaxed to 30 days, subject to the condition that the quantity of stock held beyond the existing 15 days’ limit, shall be sourced exclusively from sugar imported under Advance Authorisation Scheme (AAS) and Tariff Rate Quota (TRQ). The stockholding limit for purchase from the open market shall remain unchanged and will be restricted to 15 days’ consumption only.

items.title: Indian Railways Approves ₹493 Crore for 38.21 km New Rail Line between Mukutban (Adilabad) and Gadchandur
items.summary: In a significant step towards strengthening regional rail connectivity and facilitating faster and more efficient movement of passengers and freight, Indian Railways has approved the construction of the 38.21 km new rail line between Mukutban (Adilabad) and Gadchandur in South Central Railway at a cost of ₹493 crore.

items.title: Indian Railways Approves Doubling of Chouk-Karjat Railway Section in Maharashtra at a Cost of ₹497 Crore
items.summary: In a significant step towards augmenting railway capacity and improving train operations in Maharashtra, Indian Railways has approved the doubling of the Chouk-Karjat railway section (10.86 km) of Central Railway at a cost of ₹497 crore. The project has been approved under the umbrella works for doubling, tripling, quadrupling, flyover and bypass works aimed at augmenting the capacity of the railway network.

items.title: Ministry of Coal Successfully Launches 16th Round of Commercial Coal Mine Auctions; Executes CMDPAs for Six Coal Mines
items.summary: The Ministry of Coal successfully launched the 16th Round of Commercial Coal Mine Auctions on September 17, 2026, in New Delhi. Shri Satish Chandra Dubey, Minister of State for Coal and Mines, graced the occasion as the Chief Guest.

items.title: Semicon 2.0 to deepen India’s semiconductor ecosystem with focus on design, equipment, fabs, advanced packaging, R&D and talent
items.summary: Union Minister for Electronics and Information Technology, Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw, today outlined the implementation approach and emerging investment momentum under Semicon 2.0, highlighting the Government’s focus on developing the complete semiconductor ecosystem in India.

items.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
items.title: Union Health Ministry Proposes Amendments to Drugs Rules, 1945 to Strengthen Regulatory Oversight of Schedule H, H1 and X Drugs
items.summary: Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has proposed amendments to the Drugs Rules, 1945, through Draft Gazette Notification G.S.R. 791 (E) dated 8 th September 2026, with the objective of strengthening regulatory oversight over Schedule H, H1 and X drugs.

items.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
items.title: Union Health Ministry Issues Advisory on Regulation of Stem Cell Therapy
items.summary: The Ministry of Health & Family Welfare has issued an advisory dated 16 September 2026 to all States and Union Territories that have adopted the Clinical Establishments (Registration and Regulation) Act, 2010 , regarding regulation of stem cell therapy. The advisory has been issued in view of the judgment dated 30 January 2026 of the Hon’ble Supreme Court in Yash Charitable Trust & Ors. v. Union of India & Ors. , W.P. (C) No. 369 of 2022 [2026 INSC 96].

items.title: Cabinet approves enhancement of EPFO wage ceiling from Rs.15,000 to Rs.25,000 per month
items.summary: The Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, has approved the proposal of the Ministry of Labour & Employment to enhance the wage ceiling for mandatory coverage under the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) from Rs.15,000 to Rs.25,000 per month.

items.title: On PM Modi’s Directions, Shivraj Singh Chouhan Reaches Bihar to Assess Flood Damage and Crop Loss
items.summary: Union Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare and Rural Development Minister Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan today visited flood-affected areas of Bihar on the directions of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi and took stock of the situation on the ground.

items.title: Ministry of Coal to Launch 16th Round of Commercial Coal Mine Auctions
items.summary: The Ministry of Coal will launch the 16 th Round of Commercial Coal Mine Auctions on 17 th September 2026 in New Delhi. Shri Satish Chandra Dubey, Minister of State for Coal and Mines, Government of India, will grace the occasion as the Chief Guest. Commercial coal mining was launched by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi in 2020.

items.title: Government Eases RCMC Requirement for Export Consignments up to ₹3 Lakh
items.summary: The Government has introduced a de minimis exemption from the requirement of Registration-cum-Membership Certificate (RCMC) or Certificate of Registration for small-value export consignments up to ₹3 lakh. The measure is aimed at reducing the compliance burden for new and small exporters and facilitating exports through Postal, Courier and other emerging channels.

items.title: Cabinet Approves Higher EPFO Wage Ceiling of Rs. 25,000, Expanding Mandatory Coverage
items.summary: The wage ceiling for mandatory coverage under the E mployees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) has been enhanced from Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 25,000 per month with effect from Vishwakarma Jayanti and Sewa Divas on 17 September 2026. This was announced by Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya, Union Minister of Labour & Employment and Youth Affairs & Sports in a press briefing today.

items.ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
items.title: CCPA Imposed ₹10 Lakh Penalty on Rapido for Misleading Tipping Prompts and Dark Patterns
items.summary: The Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) , headed by Chief Commissioner Smt. Nidhi Khare and Commissioner Shri Anupam Mishra , has imposed a penalty of ₹10 lakh on Roppen Transportation Services Private Limited , which operates the ride-hailing platform Rapido , for misleading advertisements, unfair trade practices, unfair contract and dark patterns in the manner in which riders were prompted to pay more before their rides were confirmed.

items.title: Pension Sakhis to Take Retirement Security to the Doorstep of Rural India
items.summary: In a major step towards taking pension awareness and retirement security to rural households, the Department of Rural Development (DoRD) and the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) today signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to create and support a community-based outreach mechanism of ‘Pension Sakhis’ across rural India. The MoU was signed between Shri Amit Shukla, Joint Secretary DoRD, and Ms.

items.title: Commercial Coal Mine Auctions: Powering Aatmanirbhar Bharat Through Transparency
items.summary: Coal block allocation in India has undergone a significant transformation over the past decade. Following the Supreme Court's cancellation of 204 coal blocks in 2014, allocation moved to a transparent, rules-based process. The launch of commercial coal mine auctions by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi on 18 June 2020 marked the next major step.

items.title: LAUNCHING OF NEGOTIATIONS FOR THE EXPANSION OF THE INDIA-MERCOSUR PREFERENTIAL TRADE AGREEMENT
items.summary: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry of India, Piyush Goyal and the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Oriental Republic of Uruguay, Mario Lubetkin, in the exercise of the Pro Tempore Presidency of MERCOSUR announced the launch of negotiations for the expansion of the Preferential Trade Agreement between the Republic of India and MERCOSUR.

items.title: India and MERCOSUR Sign First Additional Protocol to Facilitate Electronic Certificates of Origin
items.summary: India and MERCOSUR signed the First Additional Protocol to the India–MERCOSUR Preferential Trade Agreement (PTA) to facilitate acceptance of electronic Certificates of Origin, marking an important step towards facilitating paperless trade and modernising customs procedures between India and the MERCOSUR countries. The Protocol was signed by Commerce Secretary, Government of India, Shri Rajesh Agarwal and Ambassador of Uruguay to India H.E.

items.title: Export of Power to Nepal Approved
items.summary: Ministry of Power has accorded approval for the export of power, for 18 hours a day (00:00 hours to 18:00 hours) to Nepal Electricity Authority from 13 September 2026 to 31 December, 2026. Approval has been given for upto 600MW of export through Muzaffarpur - Dhalkebar 400 kV D/c line and upto 54 MW through Tanakpur - Mahendranagar 132 kV S/c line. The quantum of power to be exported from January 2027, will be reviewed in December,2026.

items.title: Bankers’ Books Evidence Act, 2026 to come into force from 1st October 2026
items.summary: The Government has consistently pursued reforms to strengthen the banking and financial sector, promote ease of doing business and modernise the legal and regulatory framework in line with the evolving needs of the economy. With banking practices and technology evolving rapidly, laws governing banking records also need to keep pace with these changes.

items.summary: In a significant step towards strengthening digital infrastructure and accelerating broadband connectivity across rural Jharkhand, Digital Bharat Nidhi (DBN) under Department of Telecommunications (DoT) signed an Agreement for implementation of the Amended BharatNet Program (ABP) in the State under the State-led model today at Sanchar Bhawan, New Delhi. items.ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
items.title: Government amends E-Commerce Rules to strengthen consumer protection and promote transparency
items.summary: The Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India, has amended the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 through the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules, 2026 , with the objective of strengthening consumer protection while facilitating a transparent and balanced regulatory framework for the e-commerce sector.

items.title: Union Minister Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan Launches Operational Guidelines for DILRMP 3.0
items.summary: Union Minister for Rural Development, Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan, formally launched the Operational Guidelines for the Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme (DILRMP) 3.0 during a hybrid event held at Krishi Bhawan today. The launch brought together State Revenue and Registration Ministers, Principal Secretaries, and senior officials from across the country via video conferencing.

items.title: Cabinet approves five multitracking projects covering 17 Districts across the states of Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Telangana, increasing the existing network of Indian Railways by about 540 Kms
items.summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, today has approved five projects of Ministry of Railways with total cost of Rs. 10,021 crore (approx.). These projects include: The increased line capacity will significantly enhance mobility, resulting in improved operational efficiency and service reliability for Indian Railways.

items.title: Cabinet approves three multitracking projects covering 14 Districts across the states of West Bengal, Jharkhand, Odisha, Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh, increasing the existing network of Indian Railways by about 656 Kms
items.summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, today has approved 03 (Three) projects of Ministry of Railways with total cost of Rs. 10,783 crore. These projects include: The increased line capacity will significantly enhance mobility, resulting in improved operational efficiency and service reliability for Indian Railways.

items.title: Department of Land Resources to Launch Operational Guidelines for DILRMP 3.0; Set to Announce ₹565.50 Crore Digital Overhaul of Land Records
items.summary: In a major step towards making land governance more transparent, accessible, and citizen-friendly, the Department of Land Resources , Ministry of Rural Development is set to officially launch the Operational Guidelines for the Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme (DILRMP) 3.0 (2026–2031) on Thursday, 10 September 2026, at 6:30 PM.

items.title: e-FAST India, an initiative of NITI Aayog, launches PACT to support accelerated zero-emission freight deployment in India
items.summary: New platform will aggregate freight demand across India by continuous engagement with ecosystem stakeholders to facilitate scaled deployment and strengthen the commercial case for zero-emission trucks. The 5 th e-FAST India Summit also introduced the ZET Marketplace to unlock business, financing and charging partnerships.
